description: A bright country kitchen with pale green cupboards, wooden shelves and an open door to the garden. A young man in a white apron and navy T-shirt stands at the stove and laughs as he flips a pancake high into the air from a frying pan, catches it and flips it again; a plate of pancakes sits beside him. At the same time, out in the garden behind him, a golden retriever digs in a raised vegetable bed, throwing out carrots and lettuces, looks up for a moment and keeps digging.

taps.phrase: to dig up a vegetable bed
